BLE DFU Transport Defines

group BLE_DFU_Transport_Defines

Defines

MEMBER_OFFSET(struct_type, member) ((uint32_t)&((struct_type *)0)->member)

Calculate the offset of a member within a struct.

SPP_PROTOCOL_INFO 0x0011

SPP protocol information.

BLE_PROTOCOL_INFO 0x0015

BLE protocol information.

BLE_OTA_VERSION 0x1

BLE OTA version.

SPP_OTA_VERSION 0x7

SPP OTA version.

NOT_SUPPORT_BANK_SWITCH 0

Not support bank switch.

IMAGE_LOCATION_BANK0 1

Image is located in Bank0.

IMAGE_LOCATION_BANK1 2

Image is located in Bank1.

MAX_IMG_NUM (IMG_DFU_MAX - IMG_DFU_FIRST + IMG_USER_DATA_MAX - IMG_USER_DATA_FIRST)

Max image number.

IMG_INFO_LEN DFU_NOTIFY_LEN_IMG_INFO

Length of image information data.

SECTION_SIZE_LEN DFU_NOTIFY_LEN_SECTION_SIZE

Length of section size data.

MAX_BUFFER_SIZE 4096

Maximum buffer size definition.

SHA256_OFFSET (MEMBER_OFFSET(T_AUTH_HEADER_FORMAT, image_hash))

Offset for the image_hash within the T_AUTH_HEADER_FORMAT.

SHA256_LEN 32

Length of the SHA256 hash.

RELEASE_VER_OFFSET (SHA256_OFFSET + SHA256_LEN)

Offset for release version information.
